golf_options.title: Golf the code
golf_options.intro: Some transforms can be toggled on or off below; the others always apply and are listed for information.
golf_options.algebra_tooltip: Can occasionally produce invalid code on expressions involving a member access/swizzle (e.g. p.z*0.) — in that case the golf is automatically rolled back (see the "Golf cancelled" dialog). Uncheck this if that happens to you often.
golf_options.section_optional_desc: Can be toggled independently, depending on your readability or compatibility needs.
golf_options.rename_desc: Replaces every variable and function with a one- or two-letter name. The most aggressive transform: the golfed code becomes unreadable.
golf_options.dead_code_desc: Removes functions and structs that are never called, and inlines the ones called exactly once.
golf_options.algebra_desc: Simplifies trivial expressions (x*0., x*1., x+0., pow(x,2.), double negation, ...).
golf_options.section_always_desc: These transforms never change the shader's behaviour: they always run, with no checkbox to disable them.
golf_options.always_cleanup_desc: Comments removed, extra whitespace and redundant semicolons stripped, numeric literals shortened (0.50 → .5).
golf_options.always_structure_desc: Implicit "in" qualifier dropped, for loops compacted, consecutive declarations merged, braces and vector constructors simplified, if/else rewritten as a ternary where possible.
golf_options.always_macros_desc: Repeated subexpressions are factored into #define macros, but only when that actually shrinks the file.

export_shader.title: Export Compiled Shader
export_shader.not_reeditable_hlsl: The generated HLSL file is a faithful translation of the shader as it was compiled at export time. This software cannot read HLSL back in: you won't be able to paste this .hlsl file back into the editor to keep editing it here — always go back to the GLSL/WGSL source for further changes.
export_shader.not_reeditable_msl: The generated Metal (MSL) file is a faithful translation of the shader as it was compiled at export time. This software cannot read MSL back in: you won't be able to paste this .metal file back into the editor to keep editing it here — always go back to the GLSL/WGSL source for further changes.
export_shader.bindings_caveat_hlsl: If this shader uses custom textures or settings (iChannel, uniforms), the exported file wires them up following an automatic convention that may not match what your target engine expects: the file might need a small manual adjustment before it compiles as-is.
export_shader.bindings_caveat_msl: If this shader uses custom textures or settings (iChannel, uniforms), the exported file wires them up following an automatic convention that may not match what your target engine expects: the file might need a small manual adjustment before it compiles as-is.
export_shader.pixel_fidelity_caveat: There is no guarantee that recompiling this file in a third-party engine will produce a pixel-identical render compared to the live preview shown here — the translation aims for functional correctness, not a contractually guaranteed bit-exact match; verify this case by case in your target engine.
export_shader.common_tab_body: The Common tab isn't a compiled pass on its own — select a Buffer or Image tab before exporting to HLSL/Metal.
